name: Bé Chuille
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.

attributes.attribute: the witch-like daughter of the goddess Flidais
one of the most controlling women of the Tuatha Dé Danann
known also by the form Becuille

text: Bé Chuille is the daughter of the goddess Flidais, who rules the wild. She stands among the most controlling women of the Tuatha Dé Danann. Writers have chosen to call her a druidess. Her skills let her counter Carman, who is a sorceress. She works alone where most gods cannot. The name also appears as Becuille. Bé Chuille guards her people from the snares cast by magic.

okr.objective: Describe Bé Chuille as the witch-like daughter of Flidais who fought Carman.
key_results: Bé Chuille is the daughter of Flidais, goddess of the wild.
She is one of the powerful women of the Tuatha Dé Danann.
Writers describe her as a druidess.
The name may also be written Becuille.
